nodes.description: AbstractENS registry reference stored by ENSSubdomainRegistrar; all subnode ownership operations are routed through it.
Bytes32 root node owned by the registrar; used as parent for every created name and for the root-node pointer.
Mapping from permission hash (entity,app,role) to the stored parameters hash; the authoritative authorization table.
Mapping from role hash (app,role) to the address allowed to grant/revoke that permission.
Mapping from app identifier to implementation/proxy address used by Kernel and KernelProxy.
Block number at which the proxy storage was initialized; nonzero blocks re-initialization.
Mapping node => Record holding the address, content hash, name, pubkey and text/ABI sub-mappings of an ENS node.
Mapping from script hash to already deployed contract address, avoiding repeated CREATE.
One-time setup: verifies the registrar owns _rootNode then stores ens and rootNode.
Role-gated entry point that creates a subnode under rootNode for a given owner.
Role-gated creation of a subnode owned by the registrar, then points the node to a resolver and sets the target address.
Role-gated deletion: reclaims ownership of the subnode, clears the resolver and clears the owner.
Role-gated redirect of the registrar root node to the public resolver and target address.
Internal helper resolving the public resolver address, setting it on ENS and calling setAddr on it.
Internal helper reading the resolver of a node and returning the address it resolves to.
Stores an address for an ENS node in records; guarded by the only_owner modifier.
Authorization modifier requiring ens.owner(node) == msg.sender before executing the guarded body.
Resolves the script executor, ABI-encodes the call data and forwards execution via delegatecall under protectState.
Performs a raw assembly delegatecall to _dst with caller-supplied calldata and forwards/reverts returned data.
Executes a sequence of raw CALLs extracted from the script, filtering against a caller-provided blacklist.
Delegatecalls into the contract encoded in the script; rejects any non-empty blacklist.
Deploys (or reuses from cache) the contract encoded in the script and delegatecalls into it.
Assembly create of the contract bytecode appended to the script; reverts if no code is deployed.
One-time ACL setup; requires msg.sender to be the kernel and seeds the CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE permission.
Creates a brand new permission; callable only by entities holding CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE.
Grants a permission with optional parameter blob; restricted by the onlyPermissionManager modifier.
Revokes an existing permission; restricted by the onlyPermissionManager modifier.
Transfers management of a permission role to a new manager address.
Core authorization query evaluating the stored parameter expression for the caller and the ANY_ENTITY fallback.
Evaluates a single permission parameter, including oracle calls, block number, timestamp and sender parameter ids.
Helper returning uint64(block.timestamp), used as the TIMESTAMP_PARAM_ID value.
One-time kernel setup deploying the ACL proxy, registering base/instance apps and initializing the ACL.
Role-gated and integrity-checked update of an app address for a namespace/name pair.
Role-gated creation of an upgradeable app proxy bound to this kernel.
Delegates the permission query to the ACL app resolved through the kernel.
Payable fallback forwarding all calldata via delegatedFwd to the kernel implementation stored under KERNEL_APP.
Payable fallback resolving the app code and forwarding msg.data through delegatedFwd.
Payable fallback forwarding msg.data to the pinned implementation.
Proxy constructor storing kernel/appId and delegatecalling the initializer payload during deployment.
Role-gated creation of a new repo version with semantic version bump validation and contract address reuse rules.
Deploys a KernelProxy, initializes the DAO, wires the EVMScript registry and sets up initial permissions.
Deploys and wires a full APM: ENS subnode, DAO, ENSSubdomainRegistrar, APMRegistry and default repo versions.
One-time setup binding the registrar, pointing the root node to this contract and asserting ACL permissions.
Builds the raw parameter blob and consults the kernel ACL to decide whether _sender may perform _role.
Extracts the spec id from the script and returns the enabled executor registered for it.
Role-gated registration of a new script executor and its sequence id.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, ACL checks and event logging.
Miner-influenced timestamp consumed as the TIMESTAMP_PARAM_ID permission value.
delegatecall inside EVMScriptRunner.runScript executes attacker-influenced executor code in the app storage context.
Raw call() in CallsScript.execScript forwards arbitrary calldata to an address extracted from the script.
delegatecall into an arbitrary script-encoded address, running its code against the caller storage.
CREATE of script-supplied bytecode, enabling arbitrary code execution at a fresh address.
Assembly delegatecall used by AppProxyBase, AppProxyPinned and KernelProxy to forward all calldata.
delegatecall of the initializer payload during proxy construction, before the proxy is fully set up.
Storage write records[node].addr performed after the only_owner check in setAddr.
Sequence of external ENS calls (setSubnodeOwner, setResolver, setOwner) issued by deleteName.
Read of block.timestamp inside ACL.time, propagating miner-influenced data into permission evaluation.
Bytes32 ENS node passed by the caller into setAddr.
Address value that the caller wants stored for the node.
Byte script selecting the executor and encoding the forwarded call data.
Executor address resolved from the script; target of the delegatecall.
Caller-supplied list of addresses the script is not allowed to call.
Entity receiving the granted permission.
App on which the permission is granted; also used to resolve the permission manager.
Role identifier being granted; part of the manager lookup key.
Hash of the saved parameter blob (or EMPTY_PARAM_HASH) written to the permissions mapping.
Raw parameter bytes re-cast in assembly into a uint256 array before evaluation.
Entity whose permission is being checked.
Uninitialized memory pointer forcibly cast to the params array to build the auth payload.
Array of encoded permission parameters persisted through _saveParams.
Address decoded from the current script offset and used as the raw call target.
Address that will ultimately control the DAO permissions.
Newly deployed Kernel proxy returned from Kernel(new KernelProxy(baseKernel)).

edges.reason: only_owner compares the untrusted msg.sender against ens.owner(node) to authorize the call.
ACL.initialize requires msg.sender == address(kernel), so the caller identity gates one-time setup.
createPermission authorizes msg.sender through hasPermission(CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE).
msg.sender is the _who argument evaluated against the permission table.
canPerform passes msg.sender to the kernel ACL when auth/authP modifiers run.
msg.sender is emitted in LogScriptCall to record who triggered the call script.
Kernel.hasPermission forwards the caller address to the ACL for evaluation.
block.timestamp is read and truncated to uint64 inside ACL.time.
evalParam consumes time() as the value for TIMESTAMP_PARAM_ID comparisons.
hasPermission drives parameter evaluation through evalParams/evalParam.
The only_owner modifier guards the body of setAddr.
only_owner reads ens.owner(node) from the ENS state reference.
setAddr performs the records[node].addr storage write.
setAddr writes into the records mapping of the resolver.
The node parameter selects which record is written and which owner is checked.
The addr parameter is the value stored into records[node].addr.
initialize stores the ENS registry instance into the ens state variable.
initialize consumes the onlyInit guard based on initializationBlock.
createNameAndPoint calls _pointToResolverAndResolve on the freshly created node.
pointRootNode forwards the root node to _pointToResolverAndResolve.
deleteName issues the ENS setSubnodeOwner/setResolver/setOwner call sequence.
deleteName reads and mutates subnode state through the ens reference.
_pointToResolverAndResolve resolves the public resolver address via getAddr.
The resolver contract is invoked with setAddr(_node,_target) after setResolver.
getAddr calls ens.resolver(node) on the ENS registry.
runScript performs the delegatecall into the resolved script executor.
The _script parameter determines which executor is selected and the encoded calldata.
runScript assigns the resolved executor into the executorAddr local.
executorAddr becomes the delegatecall target in runScript.
runScript requests the executor for the script from the EVMScript registry.
delegatedFwd is the assembly delegatecall primitive used by all proxies.
AppProxyBase fallback forwards msg.data through delegatedFwd.
AppProxyPinned fallback forwards msg.data through delegatedFwd to the pinned code.
KernelProxy fallback forwards msg.data through delegatedFwd to the kernel implementation.
The AppProxyBase constructor delegatecalls the initializer payload when non-empty.
CallsScript.execScript performs the raw call to each decoded address.
The _blacklist parameter controls which call targets are rejected.
Blacklist entries are compared against the target before the raw call is issued.
The decoded contractAddress is the destination of the raw call.
DelegateScript.execScript delegatecalls the script-encoded address.
DeployDelegateScript.execScript deploys the script bytecode when it is not yet cached.
execScript reads and writes the cache mapping keyed by the script hash.
deploy executes the assembly create of the appended bytecode.
initialize seeds the CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE permission for the permissions creator.
createPermission requires hasPermission(msg.sender, this, CREATE_PERMISSIONS_ROLE).
The onlyPermissionManager modifier reads permissionManager[roleHash(_app,_role)].
grantPermissionP writes the resulting params hash into the permissions mapping.
paramsHash is the value stored for the granted permission.
_entity is the subject of the permission being written.
_app is part of both the permission hash and the manager lookup.
_role is part of both the permission hash and the manager lookup.
_params are persisted via _saveParams and hashed into paramsHash.
grantPermissionP requires that the entity does not already hold the permission.
revokePermission is guarded by the permissionManager state lookup.
revokePermission requires the entity to currently hold the permission.
setPermissionManager rewrites permissionManager[roleHash(_app,_role)].
hasPermission evaluates stored parameter expressions through evalParams/evalParam.
hasPermission reads the stored params for the entity and for ANY_ENTITY from permissions.
The _how byte blob is cast into the uint256 array used for parameter comparison.
The _who address keys the permission hash being looked up.
Kernel.initialize registers the ACL base and instance through _setApp.
Kernel.initialize calls initialize on the freshly deployed ACL proxy.
setApp writes apps[keccak256(_namespace,_name)] = _app.
newAppInstance is protected by auth(APP_MANAGER_ROLE, arr(...)), i.e. canPerform.
canPerform queries the kernel hasPermission entry point.
Kernel.hasPermission delegates to the ACL app resolved via acl().
canPerform builds the raw parameter blob in the how local variable.
The crafted how buffer is forwarded to kernel.hasPermission.
newDAO initializes the newly deployed kernel proxy.
_root determines the initial permission root and the final manager assignments.
The deployed dao local is the target of initialize and ACL wiring calls.
newDAO creates, grants and revokes permissions through the ACL app.
newAPM calls daoFactory.newDAO(this) to create the organization for the APM.
newAPM initializes the deployed APMRegistry after wiring ENS ownership.
APMRegistry.initialize calls registrar.pointRootNode(this), requiring POINT_ROOTNODE_ROLE.
initialize asserts ACL permissions through kernel.acl().hasPermission.
Repo.newVersion is gated by auth(CREATE_VERSION_ROLE) which resolves to canPerform.
addScriptExecutor is gated by auth(REGISTRY_MANAGER_ROLE) which resolves to canPerform.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter node only selects the record and the owner checked by the only_owner modifier.
Parameter addr is the value written by setAddr into records[node].addr.
_script is exclusively consumed by runScript to pick the executor and build calldata.
Local executorAddr is the immediate target of the delegatecall performed by runScript.
The blacklist is only used to gate the raw call executed by execScript.
_entity only parameterizes the permission write performed by grantPermissionP.
_app only parameterizes the permission key and manager lookup in grantPermissionP.
_role only parameterizes the permission key and manager lookup in grantPermissionP.
_how is only cast and compared inside hasPermission parameter evaluation.
_who is only used to build the permission hash inside hasPermission.
The local how buffer exists only to carry params into the kernel permission check.
_params are only persisted by grantPermissionP through _saveParams.
contractAddress is the decoded target of the raw call issued by execScript.
_root is only consumed inside newDAO for the initial root and manager assignment.
The dao local is only the freshly deployed kernel proxy handled inside newDAO.
